messages:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the obs-arch review  proposing a hybrid sampling signal: combine route heatmap + metric-sampled traces to decide full vs compact. Short check?

tonY: minor nit: I think you mean tony :) but yes, sketch pls.

rachel: ha, fixed. flow: 1) metric sampler (low-cost) tags candidate high-interest windows; 2) cohorter consults heatmap + recent anomaly score + SLA tier; 3) either emit FULL or COMPACT envelope. We also keep a deterministic small reservoir per-tenant for calibration. Pseudocode:
```
if anomaly_score(route,window) > ANOM_T or sla==GOLD:
  capture = FULL
else if metric_sampler.hit(route) and heatmap.hot(route):
  capture = FULL
else:
  capture = COMPACT
```

shreya: Sounds reasonable. tradeoffs?

rachel: Main tradeoffs: putting sampler at edge vs central. Edge = faster decisions and fewer bytes, but SDK/sidecar churn. Central = more control, simpler client but extra hop and potential cost. Also compact envelopes must include billing_hash + provenance_token + attribute_bitmap to allow probabilistic joins and rehydration.

marco: Ops question: how to validate attribution accuracy before flipping?

rachel: Dry-run mode: sidecar emits a flag "would_compact" but still stores full traces. Offline runner replays decisions to compute per-route: estimated_cost_savings, attribution_conflict_rate, and query_reconstruction_error. We'll require attr_conflict_rate < 0.005 for initial canary.

tonY: How to present confidence so downstream teams can safely use estimates?

rachel: We'll expose per-route "attr_confidence" (0-1) in Console + billing exports and a small note: "estimates used; request rehydrate for precise results". Also add an API to request immediate rehydration for a time range.

shreya: Rollback playbook?

rachel: Feature-flag percent by route. Alerts: attr_conflict_rate > 0.01 OR rehydrate_p95 > 2s -> auto-stepdown: reduce aggressiveness by 50% for 10m, then re-evaluate. Emergency: per-tenant full-fidelity flip for 24h if billing delta crosses threshold. Example ops toggle: curl -XPOST https://ops-api/flags?name=hybrid_sampler&percent=1

obs-bot: Created ticket OBS-6117: "hybrid-sampler + metric-backed cohorting" subtasks: schema_compact, dry-run, reservoir-size-sim, console-fields, canary-playbook.

marco: One more: metric-sampler false-positives could blow budget if it spikes. we need rate-limits and a cap per-cluster for full-fidelity windows.

rachel: Agreed: add a global token-bucket cap and per-tenant soft quota so sampler can't escalate capture beyond budget. We'll simulate worst-case spike scenarios in the dry-run.

tonY: Testing: run shadow-run + synthetic anomaly injection. I'll own synthetic workloads.

shreya: I'll prototype console fields and the rehydrate API stub.

rachel: I'll update RFC with hybrid flow, compact-envelope schema (billing_hash, provenance_token, attr_bitmap, sample_flags) and the canary guardrails. Add to Thu obs-arch agenda.

marco: Short and practical. thanks.
